videos.title: Delete your AI instructions (Claude Code's creator says so) #shorts #claude
videos.description:
Anthropic deleted 80% of its own AI instructions. On purpose.

Boris Cherny, the guy who built Claude Code tells us to do this every 6 months:
- Delete your instruction file
- Delete your skills
- Delete your hook

Then see what the model does.

What's crazy is frontier models like Opus 5 is found to be MORE intelligent without them.

The logic is simple. Most of what sits in your CLAUDE.md is correcting things the model used to get wrong. Opus 5 already gets them right, and it still reads every line, every time you work.

If you want to try it: copy your files somewhere safe, delete them, use…
